summary: Synthetic network artifact contains a clear SQLi candidate at details.entries[1].request.
Network summaries now emit bounded per-entry artifact_hints.preferredReads with kind=http-request.
MCP section resources preserve jsonPath, etag, and selected-slice sha256 so browser_sqli.request can consume a browser-result:// http-request handle directly.

notes: The runtime contract proves a network section URI with kind=http-request resolves through MCP ingress handle resolution for browser_sqli.request.
The hash is scoped to the selected jsonPath slice: unrelated raw artifact changes do not invalidate the handle, but selected request changes return HANDLE_ETAG_MISMATCH.
